item.title: Windows Spacebar File Preview Showdown: KyteView vs QuickLook vs PowerToys Peek
item.description: Want macOS QuickLook spacebar file previews on Windows 10 & 11? We compare KyteView, QuickLook, and PowerToys Peek across startup latency, Office document rendering, archive drag-extraction, and smart window offsetting.

item.title: How to Preview PPTX, XLSX & Archives in Milliseconds on Windows Without Microsoft Office
item.description: Tired of waiting for Excel or PowerPoint to launch just to check which version of a file is the right one? Learn how KyteView previews Office documents and ZIP/7z archives in under 50ms.
